title: ci(ui-merge): register `Type Check UI` in REQUIRED_CONTEXTS
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoVor7wZeUGoT2cwA6ZNospy)_

Part of #25752 (cutover step 6, the registry half). Part of #25677.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

This follows #25857 (merged as 3fca5996), which registered `Lint UI` and `Build & E2E UI`. It has no closing keyword: #25853 closed with #25857, and #25855 closed with #25856.

**Tier H.** `AGENTS.md` and `.claude/**` change because the registry's `statesTheSet` rule makes both instruction surfaces name the registry exactly. `check-governed-merges --test` reads GOVERNED, landing tier H(人合). Draft; the seat lands it once the ruling is on record.

## What changed

- `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`: one `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` row, the same shape as the two #25857 added. `ci.yml` job `type-check-ui` publishes `Type Check UI`, and `carries` says: the type-check + vitest-setup type-check family of the `ui/` workspace. The two `statesTheSet` surfaces' `mustName` arrays gain the literal, and the history comments now read 7→8.
- `AGENTS.md`, the merge-queue sentence: "seven contexts block" becomes "eight" and names `Type Check UI`; "those seven" becomes "those eight" twice. The five lines are re-filled in place, so the file stays at 1117 lines with no clause dropped and no ceiling raised. The widest touched line is 109 bytes.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`: 七个 becomes 八个 and the reading names `Type Check UI`. The file stays at 460 lines; the widest touched line is 95 bytes, under the 120-byte cap.

`Test UI` is not added; it was ruled out at the sitting (item 30 B).

## The `authorized` field (open until the ruling is relayed)

The row's `authorized` currently reads `PENDING the maintainer ruling — asked 2026-10-26T01:42Z …`. The maintainer was asked to add `Type Check UI` to the `main` ruleset after #25856 closed bill item 49. Once the director relays his words, the field will quote them verbatim and this PR gets a push. It stays draft until then.

## Deviation from the card

#25853 item 4 said "⛔ Do not add `Type Check UI`", and gave the reason: it joins after bill item 49. Item 49 is now closed. #25856 merged as fc2aaaec52, and `Type Check UI` was green on the main push run 40253800516 (job 121351290708). The epic PM ordered this row on 2026-10-26 at 01:42Z, so it is recorded here as a deviation that the epic PM ordered.

## Verification (head 4a5dec34, base `main` `c475b45b`)

- `node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` exits 0: `8 required context name(s) pinned across 3 workflow(s); 6 instruction surface(s) scanned`.
- `node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs --self-test` exits 0.
- `NODE_OPTIONS=--use-env-proxy node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs --verify-required-set` on the branch exits 0. It is report-only. Direction A reads **1**, because the ruleset click has not happened yet; direction B reads 0:

```text
required-set sweep: 7 live required context(s) on main, 1 registered-but-not-required, 0 required-but-unpinned.
    • ruleset main (id 12119582, Repository-sourced — objectstack-ai/objectstack)
    required: TypeScript Type Check
    required: Test Core
    required: Build Core
    required: Lint & Repo Gates
    required: Governed Surface Queue Guard
    required: Lint UI
    required: Build & E2E UI

  ⛔ direction A — registered here, NOT in the live required set (1).
       • Type Check UI — ci.yml job 'type-check-ui'
```

  Once `Type Check UI` is in the ruleset, the same command reads 0 / 0. That reading will be re-taken and posted here before landing.
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`): 44 commands, all exit 0 on 4a5dec34 after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint...' build`; `--ran` reconciles 44 derived, 44 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Changeset: none. Every path is repo-root tooling or instruction text and ships in no package (`skip-changeset`).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么:** 把 `Type Check UI` 登记进仓库的必过检查注册表；AGENTS.md 和 pm-dispatch 读数表里的名单同步从七个改成八个。

**为什么改:** bill 49 已由 #25856 修好：没改 `ui/` 包的 PR 上，这个检查不会再莫名变红，所以可以把它设为必过。这个 PR 是仓库这一半的改动；规则集那一半要你在设置里点。

**风险与代价(含回滚):** 只改登记和说明文字，不动 CI job 本身。你点之前，注册表多出一行，核对脚本会报“已登记、未设为必过”，只报告、不变红。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。

**席位意见:**

**你要做的:** 1) 在 `main` 规则集里加上 `Type Check UI`,并说一句（例如「加上了」）,原话会写进这一行的 `authorized` 字段；2) 批准本 PR(os-zhuang)。
